source.changelog: v1.3: (1) DOR-calibrated detection performance for AFP/CA19-9/CYFRA21-1/CEA/SCC/CA15-3; (2) New tests: NSE, ProGRP (SCLC), HPV-DNA; (3) Lynch MLH1/MSH2/MSH6/PMS2 factors + CRC/OC/GC assertions; (4) BRCA1/BRCA2 split assertions (breast + pancreatic); (5) family_history_pancreatic + family_history_thyroid; (6) OR corrections: lung family_history (1.97→1.63), gastric mirror atrophy/IM (4→3.5), HPV persistent (100→150); (7) Imaging: liver_mass PPV 50-70%, pancreatic_mass PPV 40-60%
